title: ChangeNOW Announces NOW AI After Resolving Website Integration Vulnerability
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Kingstown, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, October 15th, 2026] On October 15, with the help of independent security researchers, we found a vulnerability affecting one of the integrations used on the ChangeNOW website.
